applicability: Section 3.50.3.4 classes of bedding for trench conditions. Figure 3.46 shows six trench bedding arrangements grouped as classes A, B, C and D and prints their bedding dimensions as expressions of Bc, with plain or reinforced concrete, granular and selected fill callouts. The expressions describe bedding geometry; no computed value is printed.
notes: Unnumbered figure expressions; p230-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.

Printed callouts retained with their original punctuation: '0.25 D 10cm MIN' has no separator between D and 10cm; '0.25 Bc / 10 CM MIN' has a literal slash; '0.125 Bc 10 cm MIN UNDER BARREL' has no printed plus sign between Bc and 10. No printed separator, slash or missing plus has been repaired or supplied.
Bc and D are not defined in the figure labels or in the page text; no definitions have been added. Bc is set with a subscript c in the drawing.

Class labels and non-numeric text read verbatim: Class A CONCRETE CRADLE with PLAIN OR REINFORCED CONCRETE and CAREFULLY TAMPED BACK FILL; Class A CONCRETE ARCH with COMPACTED GRANULAR MATERIAL and PLAIN OR REINFORCED CONCRETE; Class B SHAPED BOTTOM WITH TAMPED BACK FILL (NOT RECOMMENDED) with CAREFULLY COMPACTED BACK FILL and FINE GRANULAR FILL; Class B COMPACTED GRANULAR BEDDING with CAREFULLY COMPACTED BACK FILL and COMPACTED GRANULAR MATERIAL; Class C SHAPED BOTTOM (NOT RECOMMENDED) with LIGHTLY COMPACTED BACK FILL; Class C GRANULAR BEDDING with LIGHTLY COMPACTED BACK FILL, COMPACTED GRANULAR MATERIAL and GRANULAR BEDDING; Class D FLAT BOTTOM IMPERMISSIBLE BEDDING (NOT RECOMMENDED) with LOOSE BACK FILL.
Class D carries no dimension callout; only the LOOSE BACK FILL label is printed.

Printed note inside the figure: 'NOTE : IN ROCK, TRENCH IS EXCAVATED AT LEAST 15cm BELOW THE BELL OF THE PIPE EXCEPT WHERE CONCRETE CRADLE IS USED.' The 15cm value is not an expression and is not added to the equation.

The callout '0.125 Bc 10 cm MIN UNDER BARREL' is printed vertically, reading bottom to top, and is recorded in its printed form. The embedded figure is a bitmap of about 150 dpi; a plus sign may have been lost in the source raster, but none is visible and none has been added.
